Description

Amazon Mexico TCEE team is looking for a data driven, customer-obsessed, hands on and creative candidate to join our growing AVS team.

This Vendor Specialist Team Leader will manage a team of Brand Specialists (Account Managers) from Groceries and BWS verticals.

Amazon Vendor Services is a paid service designed to help Amazon's most strategic vendors to grow and deliver the best customer experience by working across all key retail levers (e.g. selection, availability, operational efficiency, catalog quality, and marketing) or any other ad-hoc strategic vendor need. The service is delivered primarily through Brand Specialists assigned to specific vendors.

As Vendor Specialist Team Leader for Amazon Vendor Services, you will be responsible to deliver impact to a large group of vendors through a team of Brand Specialists reporting to you. Your priority will be to deliver on our commitment to help vendors improve their performance across key retail metrics, ensure their satisfaction with the service and continuously improve the productivity of your team. You will work in close collaboration with Vendor Managers and your Brand Specialists to understand your vendors’ needs and define the right goals and targets. You will meet Category Leaders on a regular basis to get guidance and help them with strategic decision making. Finally, you will be expected to contribute to continuous enhancements and innovation within the service. You should be passionate about managing and developing people, resourceful and customer focused. You need to have a proven track record of delivering results in fast-paced and dynamic business environments while managing the needs of different groups of stakeholders.

Key job responsibilities

(i) Partner with Vendor Managers, Account Managers and key retail category functions to define priorities and operational goals according to vendor needs

(ii) Manage a team of Brand Specialists owning the joint business plans for most strategic vendors and deliver significant business impact (you will be accountable for the business results of your team)

(iii) Coach and Train Brand Specialists on Amazon mechanisms, processes, tools and business topics. As a TL, you will have to develop the right skill sets within the team and allocate resources to vendors

(iv) Support the business by auditing daily business operations and drive the optimization of the business metrics

(v) Audit metrics regularly to continually drive quality of vendor and employee experience across multiple sub-categories

(vi) Own relevant business areas for your entire category, maximizing category results at scale

(vii) Work with the EU AVS team to shape the program through scaling and efficiency initiatives to drive productivity within your team

(viii) Drive vendor adoption of Amazon programs

(ix) Grow and develop people into a talent pool for Amazon

About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Aviso de Privacidad para Candidatos

En cumplimiento de lo establecido en la Ley Federal de Protección de Datos Personales en Posesión de los Particulares (LFPDPPP) y su respectivo Reglamento, Rush Street Interactive México, S. de R.L. de C.V. con domicilio en Blvd. Manuel Ávila Camacho 24, Piso 21, Lomas de Chapultepec, Miguel Hidalgo, 11000 CDMX, México (en adelante, “RSI”); es el Responsable de los datos personales que nos proporcione, por lo que hace de su conocimiento el presente Aviso de Privacidad con el fin de que conozca cómo se tratarán sus datos personales.


 Datos Personales recolectados


Los datos personales que RSI puede llegar a tratar pertenecen a las siguientes categorías:

Datos de identificación. Nombre completo, domicilio, edad, sexo, fecha de nacimiento, lugar de nacimiento, nacionalidad, Registro Federal de Contribuyentes (R.F.C.), número de Seguridad Social, Clave Única de Registro de Población (C.U.R.P.), estado civil, firma, fotografías o imágenes de su persona.

Datos de contacto. Domicilio completo, correo electrónico, número de teléfono móvil y/o fijo.

Datos financieros o patrimoniales. Información resultante de los estudios socioeconómicos que se lleven a cabo, salario actual, otras percepciones, información de cuenta bancaria, constancia de situación fiscal, clave interbancaria.

Datos laborales y académicos. Antecedentes laborales y académicos, certificados de estudio, currículum vitae, desempeño laboral, información relacionada con trabajos anteriores.

RSI También Podría Tratar Los Siguientes Datos Personales Que Se Consideran Como Sensibles (en Lo Sucesivo Se Entenderán Incluidos Cuando Se Haga Referencia a “Datos Personales”)

Datos de Salud. Estado de salud actual y pasado, tipo de sangre.

Datos Biométricos: Huella dactilar.

RSI puede recolectar los datos personales mediante la entrega directa por su parte a través de cualquier medio de contacto. También puede recolectar datos personales de manera indirecta a través de fuentes de acceso público y de otras fuentes disponibles en el mercado.


 Finalidades del Tratamiento


Los datos personales que nos proporcione, serán tratados para las siguientes finalidades:


Solicitar la hoja de vida y documentos anexos para su evaluación. 
Comunicarse por cualquier medio de contacto suministrado cuando se requiera para continuar con el proceso de selección. 
Verificar antecedentes, información personal, experiencia laboral y profesional como parte del proceso de selección. 
Contar con un registro de las personas que se presentaron en cada proceso de selección y sus resultados. 
Reportar información a las autoridades competentes en caso de que se requerido. 
Verificar información en cumplimiento de regulaciones vigentes como la relacionada con los requerimientos para la prevención del lavado de activos y la financiación del terrorismo. 
Cualquier otra finalidad directamente relacionada con los procesos de selección que adelante RSI. 


III. Transferencias de datos personales

Sus datos personales podrán ser transferidos, de conformidad con lo establecido en la LFPDPPP, en los casos en los que RSI no requiera el consentimiento del Titular para realizar transferencias de datos personales nacionales o internacionales de acuerdo con lo previsto en el artículo 37 de la LFPDPPP o en cualquier otro caso de excepción previsto por la misma u otra legislación aplicable.

Para el cumplimiento de la relación jurídica entre usted y RSI, le informamos que sus datos personales podrán ser remitidos a Encargados a nivel nacional e internacional conforme a la LFDPPP, dichas remisiones no requieren de su consentimiento.


 Medidas de Seguridad 


RSI se compromete a salvaguardar la confidencialidad de sus Datos Personales; por tanto, en cumplimiento a las políticas corporativas y a lo establecido en la Ley, RSI mantiene las medidas de seguridad necesarias con el fin de proteger las bases de datos y para evitar su pérdida, alteración, destrucción, uso, acceso o tratamiento no autorizado.


 Ejercicio de Derechos


Usted podrá en cualquier momento, (i) acceder a los datos personales que obren en poder de RSI, (ii) rectificarlos cuando sean inexactos o incompletos, inadecuados, excesivos, siempre y cuando no resulte imposible o exija esfuerzos desproporcionados, (iii) oponerse al tratamiento de los datos personales por causa legítima, (iv) cancelarlos, salvo cuando pudiese causar perjuicios a derechos o intereses legítimos de terceros o en los casos previstos por la Ley, (v) a limitar su uso y divulgación, y (vi) revocar su consentimiento (aunque esto podría no ser procedente o significar la terminación de la relación laboral).

Usted podrá ejercer dichos derechos ya sea directamente, o a través de su representante legal, a través del correo electrónico: datospersonales@rushbet.mx o mediante escrito dirigido a RSI en el domicilio ubicado en Blvd. Manuel Ávila Camacho 24, Piso 21, Lomas de Chapultepec, Miguel Hidalgo, 11000 CDMX, México.

Su Solicitud Deberá Contener y Acompañar


Su nombre y domicilio, y cualquier otro medio para comunicarle la respuesta. 
Los documentos que acrediten su identidad y/o de su representante legal. 
La descripción clara y precisa de los Datos Personales respecto de los cuales se busca ejercer alguno de los derechos antes mencionados. 
Cualquier otro elemento o documento que facilite la localización de los Datos Personales. 
En el caso de solicitudes de rectificación deberá señalar las modificaciones a realizarse y aportar la documentación que sustente su petición (cuando resulte conducente). 


En caso de dudas respecto al Tratamiento de los Datos Personales, o al procedimiento de ejercicio de derechos, por favor ponerse en contacto a través de los medios antes indicados.


 Cambios al Aviso de Privacidad 


En el evento en que se presenten cambios al presente Aviso de Privacidad, los mismos les serán puestos a su disposición al correo electrónico que nos haya proporcionado.

VII. Consentimiento 

Manifiesta que conoce el contenido de este Aviso de Privacidad y que consiente al tratamiento de sus datos personales en los términos y condiciones que se señalan en este Aviso. Dicho consentimiento lo otorga también para el tratamiento de sus datos personales sensibles y para las transferencias de sus datos personales, de acuerdo con lo antes especificado.

Workforce Intelligence, Business Analytics & Strategic Planning

📍 Guadalajara, Jalisco, México

📍 Tijuana, B.C. Mexico

🏢 On-Site

🕒 Full-Time

Help Build the Intelligence Behind the Mission

At FLF, exceptional business decisions begin with exceptional data.

As our organization continues to grow, we rely on workforce analytics, business intelligence, and operational insights to optimize performance, improve efficiency, and support strategic decision-making across the firm.

We are seeking an experienced Workforce Analytics Manager to transform workforce data into actionable business intelligence that empowers leaders, improves organizational performance, and helps shape the future of our operations.

If you're passionate about analytics, workforce planning, business intelligence, and helping leaders make smarter decisions through data, we'd love to hear from you.

Why This Role Matters

As our Workforce Analytics Manager, you will serve as the firm's trusted advisor for workforce intelligence and operational reporting.

You'll design executive dashboards, analyze workforce trends, develop forecasting models, and provide strategic recommendations that help leadership optimize staffing, improve productivity, and support sustainable growth.

Your work will directly influence workforce planning, organizational performance, operational efficiency, and executive decision-making.

Compensation & Benefits


USD Salary Compensation paid twice a month
Performance-based bonus opportunities
Career growth within a rapidly expanding organization
Ongoing professional development and technical training
Exposure to executive leadership and strategic business initiatives
Collaborative and data-driven work environment
Modern office located in Guadalajara's premier financial district


What You'll Do

Workforce Analytics & Business Intelligence


Design, develop, and maintain workforce dashboards and executive reporting solutions.
Analyze workforce utilization, productivity, staffing capacity, attendance, and operational performance.
Transform complex workforce data into meaningful insights and strategic recommendations.
Develop scorecards and reporting frameworks that provide leadership with clear operational visibility.


Workforce Planning & Forecasting


Build workforce forecasting models that support staffing decisions and organizational growth.
Analyze historical trends to identify future workforce needs and resource requirements.
Partner with department leaders to evaluate workforce utilization and staffing capacity.
Support long-term workforce planning initiatives through quantitative analysis.


Performance Measurement & Operational Insights


Evaluate workforce performance metrics, operational KPIs, and productivity measures.
Conduct root-cause analysis to identify opportunities for operational improvement.
Recommend enhancements to reporting methodologies and performance measurement frameworks.
Monitor organizational trends and communicate key findings to executive leadership.


Reporting Automation & Data Governance


Continuously improve reporting processes, dashboard functionality, and analytics capabilities.
Develop standardized reporting definitions and governance practices.
Collaborate with Technology, Operations, and Data teams to enhance reporting automation.
Identify opportunities to leverage technology and AI to improve reporting efficiency and scalability.


Strategic Business Partnership


Partner with executive leadership to support strategic planning and operational decision-making.
Present analytical findings and recommendations in a clear, concise, and business-focused manner.
Support special projects, organizational initiatives, and executive reporting requests.
Serve as a trusted advisor on workforce analytics, organizational performance, and business intelligence.


What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Operations Management, Information Systems, or a related field.
Minimum 5 years of experience in workforce analytics, business intelligence, operational reporting, or related analytical roles.
Advanced experience developing executive dashboards and reporting solutions.
Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills.
Advanced proficiency with Looker Studio, Power BI, Tableau, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, or similar business intelligence platforms.
Experience building workforce reports, dashboards, and forecasting models.
Professional proficiency in English and Spanish with strong presentation and communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications


Master's degree in a related discipline.
Experience within legal services, professional services, healthcare, or high-growth organizations.
Experience with Time Doctor or workforce productivity platforms.
Knowledge of SQL, data visualization, or reporting automation.
Experience supporting executive leadership with strategic reporting and workforce planning.
Professional certifications in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Project Management, Lean Six Sigma, or Workforce Planning.


The Type of Person Who Thrives Here

Our Most Successful Team Members Are


Curious, analytical, and business-minded
Strategic thinkers who transform data into action
Highly organized and detail-oriented
Strong communicators who simplify complex information
Collaborative partners who influence through insight
Continuous learners who embrace innovation and technology
Accountable professionals focused on measurable outcomes


Why Join FLF?

At FLF, analytics are more than reports—they're a strategic advantage.

You'll partner directly with executive leadership, influence organizational strategy, and help build the reporting infrastructure that supports one of the fastest-growing Personal Injury Law Firms.

As we continue to invest in technology, business intelligence, and operational excellence, you'll play a key role in shaping the future of our workforce and organizational performance.

About FLF

FLF is a growing Personal Injury Law Firm dedicated to helping injured individuals and their families obtain the justice and compensation they deserve.

Our success is driven by talented professionals across legal, client services, business operations, and marketing who work together to deliver exceptional results. We believe that when great people, meaningful data, and sound decision-making come together, extraordinary outcomes follow.

Our Core Values

Loyalty – To our clients, our team, and our mission.

Trust – Building confidence through transparency, consistency, and results.

Respect – For clients, colleagues, and the communities we serve.

Accountability – Taking responsibility for outcomes, both successes and mistakes.

Continuous Growth – Striving to learn, adapt, and improve daily.

Equal Opportunity Employer

FLF is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace for all team members.

Ready to Apply?

If you're excited about using data to drive smarter business decisions, improve workforce performance, and influence organizational strategy, we'd love to hear from you.

Please submit your resume along with a brief summary of a workforce analytics dashboard, business intelligence initiative, or forecasting project you developed, including the business impact your analysis helped achieve.
